Import: `import { Menubar } from "@tundralibs/ui/menubar"`

Rendered in every variant on the catalogue (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/index.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `Menubar`

```ts
Menubar(props: MenubarProps): Html
```

An application menu bar (File · Edit · View …): `role="menubar"` of
buttons, each opening a `Menu` panel beneath it. menubar.js opens on
click, switches on hover while one is open, moves between menus with
← →, opens with ↓ / Enter / Space, walks a panel's items with ↑ ↓,
closes on Escape (focus back on the button), an outside press or a pick,
and shifts a panel sideways to stay on screen. Below 768px the bar
scrolls sideways. Without the script every panel is open in flow, so
its links still work.

## Types

### `MenubarItem`

One top-level menu of the bar: a button and the panel it opens.

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string | Html` | yes |  |
| `items` | `MenuItem[]` | yes | The panel's entries — rendered with `Menu({ items })`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  | Attributes on the button. |

### `MenubarProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Required: panel ids derive from it. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the bar. @default "Application" |
| `items` | `MenubarItem[]` | yes |  |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### An editor's menu bar

Each entry's `items` is a `Menu` — links, or parents with `children` for a submenu.

```ts
Menubar({
  id: "editor-menu",
  label: "Editor",
  items: [
    {
      label: "File",
      items: [
        { label: "New", href: "/docs/new" },
        { label: "Open…", href: "/docs" },
        {
          label: "Export",
          children: [{ label: "PDF", href: "/docs/1.pdf" }, { label: "Markdown", href: "/docs/1.md" }],
        },
      ],
    },
    { label: "Edit", items: [{ label: "Undo", href: "#" }, { label: "Redo", href: "#" }] },
    { label: "Help", items: [{ label: "Documentation", href: "/help" }] },
  ],
})
```

```html
<div class="menubar" id="editor-menu" aria-label="Editor" role="menubar" data-menubar="">
  <div class="menubar__item">
    <button type="button" class="menubar__button" role="menuitem" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="editor-menu-menu-0" tabindex="0" data-menubar-button="">File</button>
    <div class="menubar__panel" id="editor-menu-menu-0" role="menu" data-menubar-panel hidden>
      <ul class="menu__list">
        <li>
          <a class="menu__link" href="/docs/new">
            <span class="menu__link-label">New</span>
          </a>
        </li>

          </a>
        </li>
        <li>

            <span class="menu__link-label">Export</span>
            <span class="menu__caret">&#8250;</span>
          </button>
          <ul class="menu__sublist" id="editor-menu-menu-0-list-sub-2" hidden>
            <li>
              <a class="menu__link" href="/docs/1.pdf">
                <span class="menu__link-label">PDF</span>
              </a>
            </li>
            <li>
              <a class="menu__link" href="/docs/1.md">
                <span class="menu__link-label">Markdown</span>
              </a>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="menubar__item">
    <button type="button" class="menubar__button" role="menuitem" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="editor-menu-menu-1" tabindex="-1" data-menubar-button="">Edit</button>
    <div class="menubar__panel" id="editor-menu-menu-1" role="menu" data-menubar-panel hidden>
      <ul class="menu__list">
        <li>
          <a class="menu__link" href="#">
            <span class="menu__link-label">Undo</span>
          </a>
        </li>
        <li>
          <a class="menu__link" href="#">
            <span class="menu__link-label">Redo</span>
          </a>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="menubar__item">
    <button type="button" class="menubar__button" role="menuitem" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="editor-menu-menu-2" tabindex="-1" data-menubar-button="">Help</button>
    <div class="menubar__panel" id="editor-menu-menu-2" role="menu" data-menubar-panel hidden>
      <ul class="menu__list">
        <li>
          <a class="menu__link" href="/help">
            <span class="menu__link-label">Documentation</span>
          </a>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </div>

</div>
```

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/menubar/menubar.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.js`, `.menu__link`, `.menubar`, `.menubar__button`, `.menubar__button--disabled`, `.menubar__item`, `.menubar__panel`

## Behaviour

`components/menubar/menubar.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-menubar`, `data-menubar-button`, `data-toggle`.
